Definition: Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or their region
BiblicalUsage: Put is a son of Ham, and the name of his descendants and their region, and of a Persian tribe. Put is listed among the sons of Ham, and Ezekiel says they of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in the army of Tyre, men of war. Nahum says Put and Lubim were the helpers of Thebes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Put is one more nation drawn into the Bible's story: a son of Ham, a soldier of Tyre, a helper of Thebes, and all of them under the judgment of God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
